Sakiai Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Marijampolės apskritis, Lithuania

Not demolished. Sakiai's Jews played a significant role in municipal politics during Lithuanian independence — seven of twelve town council members were Jewish in the 1920s — and Yudl Alfeld, a member of the Poalei Zion-Smol party, was elected mayor. On Saturday, July 5, 1941, all the town's Jewish men were forced from a holding barn, made to undress, and shot into trenches; women and children were killed in the same trenches that September, with around 1,200 people killed in total. WWII bombing severely damaged this cemetery, which was further destroyed by Soviet authorities afterward.
